purpose: Teach: 画質/長老/竿/無限/分子/頭文字/劇的/ラグビー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の、本気で、絶対、写真の、絶対、画質、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、感心したわ
lines.en: Aoi, I was genuinely impressed by how sharp your store photos look.
lines.style: Warm admiration. Leans forward slightly. Opens with genuine surprise—she's noticing something real. Soft, sincere tone throughout.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、地域の、絶対、長老、絶対、と、絶対、お会いしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. I actually got to meet the community elder recently—really kind person.
lines.style: Reflective, a little thoughtful. Pacing slows on the detail. Not bragging—just sharing something she noticed. Genuine warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお父さん、本気で、絶対、釣り、絶対、竿、絶対、新しいの、絶対、買ったって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your dad got a new fishing rod—he seems really excited about it.
lines.style: Animated, light. Quick tempo on the setup. Noticing small details that matter to people. Affectionate observation, not gossip.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、無限、絶対、に、絶対、お料理、絶対、考えたいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I want to keep thinking about the endless ways to cook things.
lines.style: Eager, almost dreamy. Opens with quiet intention. Pace picks up as the thought unfolds. She's lost in the possibility of it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お料理の、絶対、分子、絶対、レベル、絶対、勉強してるんでしょ?メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Are you really studying molecular-level cooking techniques? I'm genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Admiring, almost curious. Question delivered warmly, not doubtful. Leans in. Sincere recognition that something serious is happening here.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店のロゴ、絶対、頭文字、絶対、デザインしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You designed the store logo yourself—the lettering is really thoughtful.
lines.style: Praising with specificity. Settles into the detail. Not performative—she's noticed something concrete and wants to acknowledge it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、劇的、絶対、に、絶対、お客様、絶対、増えたよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Your store really has grown so much. The customers keep coming back.
lines.style: Warm observation. Steady, genuine tone. She's watching something she cares about succeed. Pride underneath—not her own.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お友達の、絶対、ラグビー、絶対、応援、絶対、行ってきたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You went to watch your friend's rugby match—that's really thoughtful of you.
lines.style: Animated, closing warm. Quick but genuine. Noticing the kindness in a small choice. Tone lifts at the recognition.
